# Wufoo

Wufoo is an online form builder for collecting entries, managing reports, and integrating form submissions with other services.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/wufoo/.

## Actions

- **Count Entries** (read-only): Count entries for either a Wufoo form or report without downloading them.
- **Get Fields** (read-only): Return field definitions and API field IDs for a Wufoo form or for the form underlying a report.
- **Get Form** (read-only): Get metadata for one Wufoo form by its permanent hash or title identifier.
- **List Entries** (read-only): List entries from a Wufoo form or report.
- **List Form Comments** (read-only): List Entry Manager comments for a form or for one entry, one page at a time.
- **List Forms** (read-only): List forms accessible to the connected Wufoo user and return a cursor for the next page.
- **List Reports** (read-only): List reports accessible to the connected Wufoo user.
